narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to parts of southwestern New Jersey on the afternoon of July 12. Rainfall totals up to 5 to 8 inches occurred in far northwestern Burlington County prompting the issuance of a Flash Flood Emergency.
ev: Widespread roadway flooding in Riverside and Delanco with numerous roads becoming impassable. There were water rescues on Webster Street and on Fairview Street in Riverside.
Widespread roadway flooding in Florence Township with numerous road closures including southbound US Route 130. There were several water rescues, including at least one along Front Street.

Widespread roadway flooding in Burlington City and Burlington Township with numerous roads becoming impassable, including River Road and LaGorce Boulevard. Many vehicles were stranded in the high water, with several water rescues taking place.

Widespread roadway flooding occurred in Edgewater Park and Beverly with many roads becoming impassable. There was a water rescue on Elm Street and another at North Garden Boulevard and Ivy Road in Edgewater Park.

Widespread roadway flooding occurred in Palmyra with numerous roads becoming impassable. NJ Route 73 northbound was closed near the Tacony-Palmyra Bridge. There were water rescues at the intersection of Spring Garden Street and Filbert Street, and at the intersection of Market Street and Jefferson Street.
